title: HomeMind phone pairing QR request from the 7-inch UI to the Mobile API
description: NODE-RPI5-01 (UI 'phone connect' button) to homemind-mobile-api on NODE-RPI4-01. Asks for one fresh one-time pairing offer to show as a QR on the 7-inch display; the Mobile API answers on pfn/v1/mobile/pairing/offer with the same request_id. Carries no secret. The Mobile API ignores a request whose expires_at_ms has passed, so a press is never replayed after a reconnect. Core does not subscribe.
